format: rulespec/v1
module:
  summary: '“Use this form to calculate the foreign non-business income tax credit

    for 2025 that you can deduct from the income tax payable to the province

    or territory you resided in at the end of the tax year.” The calculation

    uses T2036 lines 1 through 5 and the minimum-tax, net-income, and

    tax-otherwise-payable instructions.'
  proof_validation:
    required: true
  source_verification:
    corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/cra/t1-2025/provincial-territorial-foreign-tax-credit
    source_sha256: 7637ab494fc385b938e9e3ce4d5f3b1af8bc331ad644fe3cedefaee8434028ee

            to (c)

      0'
